in_hebrew.name: Ikey
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו God is my joy
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Ikey הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek, Ikey derives from the name Ike, meaning 'help' or 'strength.' The meaning 'God is my joy' is derived from the biblical usage of the name Ikey, found in the Old Testament. Ikey was a name given to a son born to the prophet Hosea, symbolizing God's love and joy in restoring His people.

in_latin.name: Ikey
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Icii significat 'Icii filius' vel 'Icii nepos'.
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Icii derivatur ab Icie, nomine Hebraico quod significat 'dominus' vel 'potestas'. In cultura Christiana, nomen Icii est nomen masculinum quod indicat virtutem et autoritatem. Nomen Icii habet origines Hebraicas et significat filium Icii, qui erat nomen Patriarchae et prophetae. In cultura Christiana, nomen Icii est nomen sacerdotale et indicat dignitatem et potestatem.
